future_step_reservation.rule: one screen per outer step still to come
future_step_reservation.guarantees: if a later step has a candidate, the budget does not block its first one

replay_fit_allowance.cost_note: one screen re-scores every processed cell at 3 fits each, so its cost grows with the course (15k fits at outer step k); the cap is 100% of the online arm's own projected course fits, per arm (sol v1.1 ruling 2); replay fits are their own ledger line and are never folded into the frozen arm's cost

record.v1_formula: share of ALL LLM arms' projected fits, one remainder
record.v1_1_formula: share of the online arm's OWN projected fits, per arm
record.why_not_mixed: the v1 Forward is FORWARD_SHAKEDOWN by sol's ruling and enters no curve; every scientific ordering runs under one commit and one value

budget_guard.why_before: a post-hoc budget check pays for the call it refuses; this one refuses first and bills nothing
